mapper.select: select id, student_id as studentId, course_name as courseName, score, semester, teacher_id as teacherId, teacher_name as teacherName from student_score where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into student_score(student_id, course_name, score, semester, teacher_id, teacher_name) values(#{studentId}, #{courseName}, #{score}, #{semester}, #{teacherId}, #{teacherName})
mapper.update: update student_score set student_id = #{studentId}, course_name = #{courseName}, score = #{score}, semester = #{semester}, teacher_id = #{teacherId}, teacher_name = #{teacherName} where id = #{id}
